description: Agent-first Gmail: search and read mail with full bodies in one call, send, reply and forward without hand-building MIME, manage drafts, organize mail by outcome (archive, trash, mark read, ...), fetch attachments, and manage labels.

inputs.description: Where the API is; it must be allowed below
inputs.name: api_base
inputs.title: API base URL

name: gmail
title: Gmail

tools.description: Search the mailbox and get full message contents in one call: headers, plain-text and optional HTML bodies, and attachment metadata. Replaces the list-then-get round-trips agents used to do by hand.

includeHtml.description: Include the HTML body of each message

maxResults.description: Maximum messages to return; capped at 50

query.description: Gmail search query, e.g. from:boss is:unread newer_than:7d

userId.description: The user's email address; "me" means the authenticated user

tools.name: searchEmails
tools.title: Search emails

tools.description: Read a whole conversation in one call: every message with headers and bodies, in chronological order.

userId.description: The user's email address; "me" means the authenticated user

tools.name: readThread
tools.title: Read a thread

tools.description: Send an email. The connector builds the MIME message (plain text, HTML alternative, attachments) and base64url-encodes it; the agent never hand-assembles RFC 2822.

contentBase64.description: Standard or URL-safe base64 of the file content

htmlBody.description: Optional HTML body; sent as a multipart/alternative alongside the plain text

userId.description: The user's email address; "me" means the authenticated user

tools.name: sendEmail
tools.title: Send an email

tools.description: Reply to a message in one call: reads the original's headers, addresses the reply to its sender, prefixes Re:, sets In-Reply-To/References, and threads it. The agent only supplies the reply body.

contentBase64.description: Standard or URL-safe base64 of the file content

messageId.description: The message ID to reply to

userId.description: The user's email address; "me" means the authenticated user

tools.name: replyToEmail
tools.title: Reply to an email

tools.description: Forward a message in one call: reads the original, prefixes Fwd:, and sends the note plus the original's headers and text to the recipients. Original attachments are not carried; use getAttachment plus sendEmail for full-fidelity forwarding.

body.description: Optional note to put above the forwarded message

userId.description: The user's email address; "me" means the authenticated user

tools.name: forwardEmail
tools.title: Forward an email

tools.description: Create a draft, or update it when draftId is given. Builds the MIME message like sendEmail; pass inReplyToMessageId to thread the draft as a reply.

contentBase64.description: Standard or URL-safe base64 of the file content

draftId.description: Update this draft instead of creating one

inReplyToMessageId.description: Thread the draft as a reply to this message

userId.description: The user's email address; "me" means the authenticated user

tools.name: saveDraft
tools.title: Save a draft

userId.description: The user's email address; "me" means the authenticated user

tools.description: Permanently discard a draft; cannot be undone.

userId.description: The user's email address; "me" means the authenticated user

tools.name: discardDraft
tools.title: Discard a draft

tools.description: Archive, trash, untrash, mark read/unread, or add/remove labels on messages and threads in one call. Targets can be message IDs, thread IDs, or a Gmail search query for bulk action (e.g. archive everything matching "is:unread older_than:30d"). Trash is recoverable; nothing here permanently deletes.

query.description: Gmail search query; all matching messages are acted on

userId.description: The user's email address; "me" means the authenticated user

tools.name: organizeEmail
tools.title: Organize email

tools.description: Download an attachment by attachment ID or by file name (the message is read to resolve the name). Returns the file name, MIME type, size, and base64 content.

filename.description: The file name; resolved to an attachment ID via the message

userId.description: The user's email address; "me" means the authenticated user

tools.name: getAttachment
tools.title: Get an attachment

tools.description: List, create, rename, or delete mailbox labels in one tool.

labelId.description: The label ID, for rename and delete

labelListVisibility.description: Whether the label shows in the label list

messageListVisibility.description: Whether the label shows in the message list

name.description: The label name, for create and rename

userId.description: The user's email address; "me" means the authenticated user

tools.name: manageLabels
tools.title: Manage labels

tools.description: Get the Gmail profile: the account's email address and total message/thread counts.

userId.description: The user's email address; "me" means the authenticated user

tools.name: getProfile
tools.title: Get profile
